item.title: Rabbi Shais Taub: “I Need People to Learn How to Do What I Do”
item.description: Rabbi Shais Taub says the demand for guidance has grown beyond what he can handle, and he’s launching a new course to teach others the Chassidus-based framework he uses. Full Story, Video

item.title: Vizhnitz Tish Reenacts Story of Reb Shmuel Munkes
item.description: The Purim Spiel at the annual Purim tish by the Vizhnitzer Rebbe in Bnei Brak reenacted the legendary story of the Chabad chossid R' Shmuel Munkes. Full Story

item.title: Young Shluchim From the Midwest Gather for Regional Kinus
item.description: Yaldei Hashluchim from remote communities across the Midwest gathered in Rochester, MN, for a Shabbos of connection, chizuk, and fun. Full Story

item.title: New Mikvah and Jewish Family Life Center Opens at Texas A&M University
item.description: The Jewish community of College Station, Texas marked a historic milestone with the grand opening of the Avigdor & Devorah Grinshtein Jewish Family Life Center, a state-of-the-art mikvah and educational facility serving students and families. Full Story

item.title: A Family Lost Their Home. We Can Give It Back Today
item.description: Today, if we come together as a community, we can raise what is needed to help this family return to their home. Video

item.title: Live: 30 Letters in 30 Days
item.description: Live at 10:00 PM ET: Rabbi Shais Taub re-launches his annual “Thirty Letters in Thirty Days” live series, beginning Motzei Shabbos at 10 PM ET, as a 30-day preparation for the Rebbe’s birthday featuring nightly classes on letters from Volume 12 of Igros Kodesh. Live

item.title: Rabbi Moshe Pinson Talks About His Fundraising Life
item.description: Clappy and Frank Podcast: Rabbi Moshe Pinson, founder of Cong. Beis Shmuel in Crown Heights Shul, who is involved in many endeavors, speaks candidly about fundraising. Video

item.title: Chaveirim Across NY Back Governor’s Push to Lower Car Insurance
item.description: Chaveirim serving Crown Heights has joined the New York State Chaveirim Coalition in backing Governor Kathy Hochul’s plan to reduce auto insurance premiums across New York. Full Story

item.title: Shabbos: N’shei Chabad Farbrengen Marks the Rebbetzin’s Birthday
item.description: Women are invited to join the N’shei UBnos Chabad Farbrengen honoring the birthday of Harabonis Hatzidkonis Rebbetzin Chaya Mushka Schneerson. Full Story

item.title: What If My Tzedakah Exceeded Maaser?
item.description: Question: My tzedaka giving exceeded a tenth of my annual income. May the excess be applied toward next year’s maaser? Answer by Rabbi Mendel Prescott, Rosh Yeshiva of Machon Smicha. Full Story
